questions.stem_text:
Sullivan's (2000) study suggested that the proportion of housework men did was greatest
when:

options.A: they had rediscovered themselves as 'new men'
options.B: their wives were at home and nagged them all the time
options.C: exciting gadgets like the hoover and electric iron were invented
options.D: they were unemployed or both partners worked full time

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - they were unemployed or both partners worked full time

questions.stem_text: In the context of the labour movement in the nineteenth century, 'incorporation' meant:

options.A: including union representatives in processes of policy decision making
options.B: creating links between the state and corporate organizations
options.C: recruiting women into full time paid employment
options.D: including working class organizations in political bargaining and representation

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - including working class organizations in political bargaining and representation

options.A: ways of acting, thinking, and feeling that are collective and social in origin
options.B: the way scientists construct knowledge in a social context
options.C: data collected about social phenomena that are proven to be correct
options.D: ideas and theories that have no basis in the external, physical world

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - ways of acting, thinking, and feeling that are collective and social in origin

questions.stem_text:
Marx said that the development of the labour movement through factory-based production
would turn the working class into:
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - a class for itself

questions.stem_text: Society cannot be studied in the same way as the natural world because:

options.A: human behaviour is meaningful, and varies between individuals and cultures
options.B: it is difficult for sociologists to gain access to a research laboratory
options.C: sociologists are not rational or critical enough in their approach
options.D: we cannot collect empirical data about social life

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - human behaviour is meaningful, and varies between individuals and cultures
